title: add rag agent quickstarts, tool-calling examples, and docs site update
author: Priya Raman
description: Adds a set of RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts across redwood-examples and the docs site. Motivation: provide opinionated, runnable examples for engineers evaluating RAG + tool-calling patterns with Redwood and ship consistent quickstarts for Python and TypeScript SDKs. This PR includes: 1) new RAG agent templates (search + tool orchestration) with README and example datasets in redwood-examples/agents; 2) tool-calling examples demonstrating function/tool registration, typed tool responses, and structured output parsing for both Python and TypeScript SDKs; 3) docs site updates (new guide, updated navigation, example screenshots, minimal config for Private/Dedicated); 4) unit/integration tests for example agents and CI workflow additions to build and publish docs pre-merge. Checklist: - [x] RAG templates added and documented - [x] Python and TypeScript quickstarts included - [x] Tests for example agents - [x] Docs site nav updated and link checks passing - [x] CI workflow updates for docs build Notes: the examples are intentionally minimal (small vector index fixture) and include guidance to swap in customer vector stores. Authentication/environment variables are documented in each example README. See linked Linear tickets for product context.
